summary_zh: 本页为绘本的章节标题页，显示第3章的标题为《乘秋千旅行的猫》，背景为浅橙色，右侧有模糊的猫形剪影。

page_text_ocr_zh:
从前，有一只猫，是一只黑黑的猫。

黑猫不是神猫，也不是那种蹲在巫婆脚边、懂一点魔法的猫。

这是一只普普通通的猫，但他有九个名字。

为什么有九个名字呢？因为黑猫听老人们说，猫有九条命。有九条命的猫不该有九个名字吗？这九个名字分别是——胆大、敢冲、勇猛、冒险、玩命、不怕死、死不了……

我记不全，反正都是些胆大、不怕死的名字。有九条命的猫还怕什么呢？
page_text_en:
Long ago, there was a cat, a black cat.

The black cat was not a magical cat, nor was it the kind that crouched by a witch's feet and knew a little magic.

This was an ordinary cat, but he had nine names.

Why nine names? Because the black cat heard the elders say that cats have nine lives. Shouldn't a cat with nine lives have nine names? These nine names are—brave, daring, courageous, adventurous, reckless, fearless, and invincible...

I can't remember them all, but they're all names like brave and fearless. What could a cat with nine lives be afraid of?
summary_zh: 本页介绍了故事主角——一只普通的黑猫，他有九个名字，分别代表勇敢、冒险等特质，引出他不怕危险的性格特点。

page_text_ocr_zh:
话说有那么一天，森林里下了一场暴雨，黑猫想外出走走。他撑起伞走了没多远，天晴了起来，黑猫收起伞，抬头看天。
天空没有一丝云彩，瓦蓝瓦蓝的。

“多么美丽的天空，多么新鲜的空气，真应该飞上蓝天去旅行呢！”
猫是没有翅膀的，黑猫没法飞上天。

黑猫一扭头，看见旁边有棵大榉树，大榉树上挂着一架秋千。黑猫跳上秋千，使劲地荡了起来。
秋千越荡越高，耳边风声呼呼，黑猫得意极了。
page_text_en:
Once upon a time, it rained heavily in the forest. The black cat wanted to go out for a walk. He held his umbrella and walked a short distance. Then the sky cleared up, so the black cat put away his umbrella and looked up at the sky.
There wasn't a single cloud in the sky; it was a deep, clear blue.

"What a beautiful sky, what fresh air! I really should fly up into the blue sky and go on a journey!"
Cats don't have wings, so the black cat couldn't fly.

The black cat turned his head and saw a big zelkova tree nearby, with a swing hanging from it. The black cat jumped onto the swing and started swinging hard.
The swing went higher and higher, and the wind whistled in his ears. The black cat was thrilled.
summary_zh: 黑猫在雨后晴朗的天空下，看到大榉树上的秋千，便跳上去尽情荡秋千，感到非常得意。

page_text_ocr_zh:
这时，一只小松鼠说：“黑猫，太危险了，你会从秋千上飞出去的！”
“猫有九条命，死不了的！我正想着乘着秋千飞出去旅行呢……”
此时，秋千已经飞到了高高的天空，黑猫一松手，就从秋千上飞了出去。

黑猫飞过青松林的时候，一棵大青松看见了，大青松说：“太危险了，让我拉你一把！”
太危险了！
page_text_en:
At this moment, a little squirrel said, “Black Cat, it’s too dangerous! You’ll fly off the swing!”
“Cats have nine lives, I can’t die! I’m just thinking of flying off the swing on a trip…”
At this point, the swing had already flown up into the high sky, and the black cat let go, flying off the swing.

As the black cat flew over the pine forest, a big pine tree saw him. The big pine tree said, “It’s too dangerous! Let me pull you back!”
Too dangerous!
summary_zh: 黑猫在秋千上飞得太高，小松鼠和大青松都担心他太危险，黑猫却认为自己有九条命，不惧危险，最终松手飞了出去。

page_text_ocr_zh:
黑猫说：“闪开，我是有九条命的猫！”
大青松听了，在黑猫的屁股上使劲拍了一巴掌，黑猫飞得更高更快了。
黑猫飞过白桦林
时，一只大猩猩正在树上看书，他看见一只黑猫从远处飞来，想用书挡住黑猫，救他下来。
黑猫说：“别挡我，我是有九条命的猫！”
大猩猩就用书拍了一下黑猫的屁股，黑猫飞得更快更高了。
page_text_en:
The black cat said, “Get out of the way, I’m a cat with nine lives!”
Big Green Pine heard this and gave the black cat a hard slap on the bottom. The black cat flew even higher and faster.
The black cat flew over the birch forest.
At that moment, a big gorilla was reading a book in the tree. He saw a black cat flying in from afar and tried to block him with the book, to save him.
The black cat said, “Don’t block me, I’m a cat with nine lives!”
The gorilla then slapped the black cat’s bottom with the book, and the black cat flew even faster and higher.
summary_zh: 黑猫在空中飞得越来越高，大青松和大猩猩先后试图用拍打的方式阻止他，但黑猫坚持自己有九条命，不惧危险，反而飞得更快更高了。

page_text_ocr_zh:
黑猫飞过森林，飞过山峰，飞得越来越高，越来越远，周围连一只鸟都没有了。
黑猫开始害怕了，他不知道自己的九条命在哪儿，眼前他只有一条命，要是摔了下去，他会粉身碎骨，那就一条命也没有了。
黑猫发现自己开始从高空往下面掉，他吓得浑身打战，大声哭叫起来。
黑猫的眼泪飘下天空，落在一个山尖上。山尖上只有只小羚羊正在晒太阳，黑猫的一颗泪珠打在他的鼻尖上。
小羚羊抬头一看，他大声地说：
“怎么又下雨了？还飘过一朵小小的乌云，好奇怪，乌云还拿着一把伞！”
怎么又下雨了！
page_text_en:
The black cat flew over the forest, over the mountain peaks, flying higher and higher, farther and farther, with not a single bird in sight.
The black cat began to be afraid. He didn't know where his nine lives were. In front of him, he had only one life. If he fell down, he would be shattered to pieces, and then he would have no life left.
The black cat realized he was beginning to fall from the high sky. He trembled all over and cried out loudly.
The black cat's tears drifted down from the sky and landed on a mountain peak. On the peak, there was only a little gazelle sunbathing. A single tear from the black cat hit the gazelle's nose.
The gazelle looked up and shouted loudly:
"It's raining again? And a tiny little dark cloud is floating by. How strange! The cloud is even holding an umbrella!"
It's raining again!
summary_zh: 黑猫在高空中坠落，感到恐惧并开始哭泣，他的眼泪落在山尖上，被正在晒太阳的小羚羊看到，小羚羊误以为下雨了，还注意到乌云拿着伞，感到非常奇怪。

page_text_ocr_zh:
黑猫听见这话，才想起手中还有一把伞，他连忙把伞撑开，伞带着黑猫飘了起来。
小羚羊更惊奇了，他说：“一朵撑伞的乌云！”
伞快撑不住了，黑猫一直往下掉。黑猫吓坏了，大声叫着：“救救我，谁来救救只有一条命的猫……”
幸好，不远处有一座城堡，城堡有个高高尖尖的顶，黑猫拽住城堡的尖顶，落了下来。
城堡里，国王、王后和小王子抬头看见一只黑猫，夹着一把伞从城堡顶上，正小心翼翼地往下爬。
page_text_en:
The black cat heard this and remembered he still had an umbrella in his hand. He quickly opened it, and the umbrella carried the black cat up into the air.
The little gazelle was even more surprised. He said, "An umbrella-carrying dark cloud!"
The umbrella couldn't hold on anymore, and the black cat kept falling down. The black cat was terrified and shouted, "Help me! Who will save the cat with only one life...?"
Luckily, not far away was a castle with a tall, pointed roof. The black cat grabbed onto the castle's peak and landed safely.
Inside the castle, the king, queen, and little prince looked up and saw a black cat, holding an umbrella, carefully crawling down from the castle's roof.
summary_zh: 黑猫在空中坠落时撑开伞，被误认为是撑伞的乌云，最终抓住远处城堡的尖顶安全落地，城堡里的国王、王后和小王子看到这一幕感到惊讶。

page_text_ocr_zh:
国王大声说：“一只好大胆的猫！”
黑猫被带到国王跟前，国王问他：
“你怎么这么大胆，敢在城堡的尖顶上
爬？”

黑猫说：“是活下去的勇气。因为我
只有一条命，我不想把命丢了，就得大
胆、小心地爬下城堡的顶。”

国王笑了，他说：“你是一只懂得珍
惜生命的猫。懂得珍惜生命的人，会
好好过自己的一生！”

“对。”黑
猫很恭敬地
说，“我要好好
地过一生！”
page_text_en:
The king shouted, "What a brave cat!"

The black cat was brought before the king, who asked him:
"How dare you climb so boldly to the top of the castle?"

The black cat replied, "It's the courage to live. Because I
only have one life, I don't want to lose it. So I must be
brave and careful as I climb down from the castle's peak."

The king smiled and said, "You are a cat who understands
how to cherish life. Those who cherish life will
live their lives well!"

"Right," the black cat said respectfully, "I want to live my life well!"
summary_zh: 黑猫被带到国王面前，国王称赞他大胆，黑猫解释自己是因为珍惜生命才勇敢，国王肯定了他，并鼓励他好好过一生，黑猫恭敬地表示赞同。

page_text_ocr_zh:
国王很喜欢这只黑猫，就把他留在城堡里，让他当小王子的伙伴和老师。
小王子在黑猫的影响下，懂得了要珍惜自己的生命，还要珍惜王国每一个臣民的生命的道理。后来，小王子成了一个很好的国王。
黑猫离开森林很久了，开始怀念家乡。
小国王听从黑猫的要求，派了一辆漂亮的马车，把年老的黑猫送回了森林。
这只乘着秋千飞上天的黑猫，是乘着国王的马车重返森林的。
再见！
page_text_en:
The king liked this black cat very much, so he kept him in the castle, letting him be the young prince's companion and teacher.
The young prince, influenced by the black cat, learned to cherish his own life and also to cherish the lives of every subject in the kingdom. Later, the young prince became a very good king.
The black cat had been away from the forest for a long time and began to miss his hometown.
The young king, following the black cat's request, sent a beautiful carriage to return the old black cat to the forest.
The black cat who flew up to the sky on a swing is the one returning to the forest in the king's carriage.
Goodbye!
summary_zh: 黑猫在城堡中成为小王子的老师，影响他学会珍惜生命，小王子后来成为好国王；黑猫因思念家乡，小国王派马车送他重返森林，画面中黑猫乘着马车离开，与大家道别。

page_text_ocr_zh:
重返森林的黑猫，关心和爱护着
森林里的每一个伙伴。他让他们懂得
珍惜自己的生命，好好过自己的一生
的道理。
据说，这只很老很老的黑猫，至今
还生活在那座森林里……
page_text_en:
The black cat, returning to the forest, cares for and protects
every companion in the forest. He teaches them to cherish
their own lives and live their lives well.
It is said that this very old, very old black cat still
lives in that forest today...
summary_zh: 黑猫重返森林，继续关心和爱护森林里的伙伴，教导他们珍惜生命，好好生活。据说，这只年迈的黑猫至今仍生活在那座森林里。
